title: Centra celebrates opening of new Langhorne Medical Center - NewsBreak
text:
By Michael Doti ,
1 hours ago
LYNCHBURG, Va. ( WFXR ) – Wednesday morning’s ribbon-cutting marked the opening of Centra’s new Langhorne Medical Center.
It took around a year and a half to complete the building, and it’s the first major project in Centra’s multi-year modernization plan.
“It’s a huge excitement to get here,” Centra’s President and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Richard Tugman said. “There’s been a lot of worries to put buildings like this together, but to finally see it come together is an amazing experience.”
The building is five stories tall and approximately 130,000 square feet.
It houses new technology and 13 outpatient specialties, including imaging, neurosurgery, and endocrinology. The bigger space also benefits the practitioners.
Photo courtesy of Centra Health Photo courtesy of Centra Health Photo courtesy of Centra Health “Currently, there are days when we have providers who can’t see patients because there aren’t enough rooms to get them seen in,” Al Baker, a pulmonary medicine physician at Centra, said. “Just having more rooms to get patients in lets us see more patients, so waiting times for appointments are shorter and we can do the right thing quicker.”
City officials came to celebrate the opening, including Mayor Larry Taylor and Delegate Wendell Walker.
Both are excited about a medical facility designed for modern, patient-centered care in Lynchburg.
“It takes a lot of anxiety away, because you say, ‘I have to get up at 6:00 in the morning to drive to Charlottesville,’ or ‘I have to be in Charlottesville by midnight,’ Taylor said. “No, you can come right here, leave your house, and come right to this facility, and your needs are met.”
“Lynchburg is a great city where you have the aging population and a young population,” Walker said. “For those of us on the aging side, it’s always nice to know that the doctor is just around the corner, so right here in Lynchburg, folks, Centra Health is answering the needs that we have.”
The Centra Langhorne Medical Center will begin seeing patients on December 8th, and they can now check in, fill out forms, and submit copays on their phones before coming into the building.
